method.source: SYN-DIGITS Table 8 elastic-net settings; tau from the paper's adaptive-transfer rule
method.adaptive_gate: calibrated prediction when train_mse <= 0.15, otherwise the uncalibrated digital-twin response

aggregation.main: full 1,921-person clean pool with fixed 40-cell poststratification weights
aggregation.moderators: restrict the full clean pool to the requested one-way moderator level and renormalize the same fixed respondent weights within that subset
aggregation.tier3: poststratified intervention mean minus poststratified pooled-control mean

poststratification.formula: target cell proportion / clean-pool cell proportion
poststratification.moderator_rule: restrict the full clean pool to the requested one-way moderator level and renormalize the same fixed respondent weights within that subset

unsupported_moderator_cells.rule: organizer-prescribed no-moderation fallback: repeat condition mean

transfer_gate.applied_as: post-fit column selection between the elastic-net prediction and the raw digital-twin response; no refitting
